meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行开发计划，并行调度多个子代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你希望让代理按既定计划自动推进开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Execute your development plan automatically while coordinating parallel subagents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to follow a defined plan and handle multiple subtasks in parallel.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 变成计划执行编排者：不亲自写代码或改文件，把所有实现、测试、验收都派给子代理并行做，自己只管选计划、记录状态和勾选完成项，直到计划全部执行完毕。
howto.when: 在规划完成后，当你说“ulw-execute”、“execute plan”等，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发。

say.note: Claude 会读取该计划并开始逐项执行。
从上次未完成的检查点接着做。

say.text: 执行计划并用 --make-pr 提交
say.note: 完成时会创建拉取请求，不会自动合并。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates plan execution: it never implements itself; it splits tasks into units, spawns parallel subagents to do the work, and only selects plans, updates state, and checks off completed items until the plan is fully executed.
howto.when_en: Triggers after planning when the user says 'ulw-execute', 'execute plan', etc., or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: Claude reads that plan and starts executing item by item.
Picks up from the last unfinished checkpoint.
Creates a pull request on completion; does not merge automatically.
